brief: Goldman Sachs's derivatives desk argues that summer is over, positioning is neutral, the near-term catalyst path is rich and volatility is extremely cheap, so conditions favor adding convexity across both micro and macro. It prefers owning right-tail expressions through options, with AI back in focus, while still seeing merit in tactical protection against near-term macro risk. Implied move through the end of the week is 0.91%, with CPI on Friday and ORCL and ADBE reporting. In micro, 1-month at-the-money implied vol for the NDX average stock fell from about 57v to about 40v and put call skew sits near its flattest in 20 years, so the desk buys GSCBTC10 upside into the week after Communacopia, when the most in-demand tech has historically outperformed, and HOOD Nov 145/180 call spreads at $4.50 on Rothera's scaling. Demand for memory convexity has returned. In macro, the lowest S&P 6-month realized correlation ever is judged unsustainable and has historically preceded index vol convexity, so the desk buys IWM 286 puts against an above-consensus CPI forecast and VIX 20/30 call spreads. Light Exo offers a Feb'27 25% strike software dispersion palladium at 6.81%.
